name: BrowserSkill
description: Lets agents drive your logged-in Chrome or Edge in a separate window, inspect network traffic and page performance, through a CLI and local MCP.

skills.name: Inspect requests
skills.description: Reads retained request headers, submitted data, response bodies, timing and errors, filtered by traffic.

skills.name: Investigate performance
skills.description: Inspects page-load metrics, API timing summaries and suspected duplicate requests on a page.

skills.name: Mock and test
skills.description: Configures request modification, blocking and mock responses for a task, and keeps the evidence.
